text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having missed the Shield, Mejiro Bright 
showed her frustration and vowed to bounce 
back. Seeing her indomitable spirit, 
Mejiro Dober felt something akin to 
admiration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After wishing she could be like Bright, 
Mejiro Dober realized that all this time, 
she had only ever thought about becoming 
"someone else."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because she lacked confidence, she had 
always chased in someone else's wake. Yet, 
truly radiant beings are all resolved to 
shine through their own strength and in 
their own way—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With this realization, Mejiro Dober 
resolves to face her own weaknesses in 
order to become a source of "new glory for 
the Mejiro family."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not to become like "someone else." It is 
all to become the truly strong Mejiro 
Dober! Betting on her comeback, she sets 
her sights on the Takarazuka Kinen.
